Hi Aileen,

Thanks again for joining our "Building reliable LLM inference" webinar yesterday and for trying Redwood's self-serve flow. I saw you spun up a model briefly — great to see.

If you're open to a short 30-minute walkthrough, we'd focus on:
- Dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs for production
- Private (VPC) options and compliance notes
- A quick look at how we reduce per-token costs with caching/batching

Here are a few slots (PT):
- Wed 8/19 10:00–10:30
- Wed 8/19 14:00–14:30
- Thu 8/20 09:00–09:30

If none of these work, tell me your timezone and 2 windows that do. I've attached a quick agenda and a Calendly link if you prefer to pick a time directly.

Agenda attached: redwood-30min-demo-agenda.pdf
Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo

Thanks — looking forward,

Ben Carter
Solutions Development | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

--
